round: V32: stage 3 trained on strong-search episodes only
status: frozen before pool generation, training and any outcome of this round
motivation: V31's 12288 gain came from more games reaching 6144: P(12288|6144) stayed ~10% (V23 79/790, V31 115/1215) and the stage-3 residual gave +1.0 pp on fixed first-6144 states (n.s.). Stage-3 training moves were 99.7% two-move policy. Pilot (256 V27 training states, W31, timing/strength only): reach 12288 by depth 1/2/3/5(.01) = 0.4/2.0/5.9/13.3%, at 0.002/0.009/0.45/3.15 ms per move; 3(.01) 3.5% 0.10 ms; 4(.01) 7.0% 0.98 ms; 4(.03) 5.5% 0.51 ms.

training.tool: training/v32-strong/train.cpp (V31 trainer; configurable strong player; wall-clock budget)
training.start: W31 stage-3 four-cell table and residual (fine-tuning)
training.concurrency: T3 and T5 run at the same time, 8 threads each, so both get the same wall time on the same machine
training.throughputPilot: 60 s, both arms concurrently: T3 ~15.7k moves/s (3.8% of episodes reach 12288), T5 ~1.9k moves/s (12.8%); pilot models discarded unevaluated

T3.what: every episode played by complete 3-ply expectimax (clamped): ~8x more data than T5

T5.what: every episode played by the website search itself (5-ply, cutoff 0.01, clamped): on-policy values for the deployed search

pool.policy: W31 website search to the first 6144 (training/v31-stages/bin/tools pool rank 14); terminal states excluded; sorted by seed, first 2048

screen.rule: winner = more 12288s among T3 and T5; tie -> higher total scoreGained; then T3. W31 (reused V31 c3 results, same seeds) is descriptive. No test.

confirm.compare: screen winner vs W31 on the fresh pool, website search (5-ply, cutoff 0.01, clamp), to 12288 or death
confirm.secondary: scoreGained paired difference, Wilson intervals, avoidable deaths, CPU ms/move

adoption: Offline round. A website update would need the V31 release checks again (quantization, parity, timing) and is decided separately; adoption requires a significant primary gain and no significantly worse scoreGained.
compile: c++ -std=c++17 -O3 -pthread training/v32-strong/train.cpp -o training/v32-strong/bin/train; tools as in V31
